basics.name: Omar Olivares Urrutia
basics.label: AI / Machine Learning Engineer — LLM Agents, Evaluation & RAG Systems
basics.summary: AI/ML engineer specializing in LLM agents, evaluation, and production RAG systems. Equal parts researcher and builder: benchmarked 19 LLMs on SQL error detection for a peer-reviewed paper (CLEI 2026) and helped launch one of the fastest-growing open-source coding agents. Hands-on across the full ML lifecycle — data collection, fine-tuning, evaluation, and serving at scale — with a focus on AI products people actually use.

publications.name: Assessing the Ability of Large Language Models to Detect and Classify Errors in SQL Queries
publications.summary: Full paper at CLEI 2026 (Computer Education track) — IEEE-published, Scopus-indexed, 34% acceptance rate (102 of 297 submissions). The study evaluates how well 19 LLMs detect and classify errors in SQL queries, using LLM-as-a-Judge scoring over 300 test cases against human-annotated ground truth, with direct applications in automated tutoring for database education. To be presented in Mexico City, September 2026.

publications.name: Optimization of Language Models for Chile's Mathematics Higher Education Admission Test (PAES)
publications.summary: Fine-tuned GPT-3.5 for Chile's PAES mathematics exam, raising accuracy from 78% to 94% (+16 points) through targeted optimization and OCR/transcription pipelines.
